title: Pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Blades -->
  <polygon points="42,42 88,10 92,16 48,46" fill="#cdd8e6" stroke="#eef4ff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="52,44 92,84 86,88 50,50" fill="#b8c8dc" stroke="#eef4ff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Blade highlights -->
  <polygon points="46,44 82,17 84,20 48,46" fill="#f0f6ff"/>
  <polygon points="54,48 84,82 82,84 53,50" fill="#edf4ff"/>
  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="5" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="2.5" fill="#ffd97a"/>
  <!-- Left handle -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="62" rx="10" ry="16" transform="rotate(30 28 62)" fill="#ff5c7a"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="62" rx="5" ry="10" transform="rotate(30 28 62)" fill="#ff9eb0"/>
  <!-- Right handle -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="80" rx="10" ry="16" transform="rotate(-20 34 80)" fill="#ff5c7a"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="80" rx="5" ry="10" transform="rotate(-20 34 80)" fill="#ff9eb0"/>
  <!-- Handle connectors -->
  <path d="M42,42 Q32,50 28,54" stroke="#ff5c7a" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44,46 Q36,58 34,66" stroke="#ff5c7a" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
